schemes.name: Node CAFE (Multi-Sensor LPP)
schemes.description: Created directly from packet payload cafe96b840eb0102... (32B)

schemes.name: Standard 2-Byte Node ID + TLV / IPSO Channels
schemes.description: Decodes 2-Byte Node ID (0..1) + Header + dynamic TLV / Cayenne LPP sensor channels (Temp, Batt, Hum, Accel, GPS, Switch)
schemes.matchCondition:
// Match standard 4+ byte header
return bytes.length >= 4;

schemes.name: Cayenne LPP Standard Sensors
schemes.description: Decodes standard IPSO/Cayenne LPP sensors (temp, hum, analog, accel, GPS)
schemes.matchCondition:
// Match Cayenne LPP channels
return bytes.length >= 3 && (bytes[1] === 0x67 || bytes[1] === 0x68 || bytes[1] === 0x02 || bytes[1] === 0x01 || bytes[1] === 0x71 || bytes[1] === 0x88);
